tr: Springy Legs
The hopper can long jump 20 feet with or without a running start.
Prickly
A creature that touches the hopper or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
a: Thorny Kick
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Burr Spit
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

tr: Swarm
The swarm can occupy another creature's space and move through openings large enough for a Tiny moth. It can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
Glow
The swarm sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.
a: Fluttering Wings
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) slashing damage, or 5 (2d4) if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.
Dazzle (Recharge 5–6)
Each creature within 10 feet of the swarm must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

la: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak
tr: Watchful
The eye can't be surprised and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
a: Multiattack
The eye uses Gaze of Lies twice, choosing a different ray each time.
Gaze of Lies

The eye fires one of these rays at a creature it can see within 60 feet. Sting of Doubt: ranged spell attack +5 to hit, 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Fibbing Flash: DC 12 Wisdom save or the target believes the floor around it is crumbling and spends its next move backing away from the eye. Wobble Ray: DC 12 Constitution save or the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
Bite
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

tr: Paving Disguise
While curled up and motionless, the golemling looks like a pile of cobblestones.
Sturdy
The golemling has advantage on saving throws against being pushed or knocked prone.
a: Multiattack
The golemling makes two Slam attacks.
Slam
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Rolling Tumble (Recharge 5–6)
The golemling rolls up to 30 feet in a straight line. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

tr: Mist Step
As a bonus action, the fog weaver teleports up to 30 feet to a space it can see that is filled with fog or mist.
a: Multiattack
The fog weaver makes two Mist Lash attacks.
Mist Lash
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) cold damage.
Fog Veil (Recharge 5–6)

The fog weaver fills a 20-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet with thick fog for 1 minute. The area is heavily obscured. Each creature that starts its turn in the fog must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the start of its next turn.

tr: Shell Shelter
As a bonus action, the tortoise pulls into its shell. Until it emerges (bonus action), its AC is 22 and its speed is 0.
a: Bite
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Shell Bash
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Thunder Stomp (Recharge 5–6)
Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) thunder damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

tr: Gear Lock
The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects that would move it.
a: Multiattack
The drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
The drake exhales scalding steam in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

tr: Watchful
The eye can't be surprised and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Whispering Lids
Creatures within 30 feet hear faint, mocking whispers; they have disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.
a: Multiattack
The eye uses Gaze of Lies three times, choosing a different ray each time.
Gaze of Lies

The eye fires one of these rays at a creature it can see within 90 feet. Ray of Doubt: DC 16 Wisdom save or the target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn and takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage. Tangled Truth: DC 16 Wisdom save or the target uses its reaction to move up to half its speed toward a spot the eye chooses. Hollow Echo: DC 16 Intelligence save, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. Weight of Lies: DC 16 Constitution save or the target takes 18 (4d8) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
Bite
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

tr: Snow Walker
Ice and snow are not difficult terrain for the shepherd.
a: Multiattack
The shepherd makes three Ice Crook attacks.
Ice Crook
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.
Hurl Ice Block
Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Call the Avalanche (Recharge 6)

Snow crashes down in a 30-foot cube within 120 feet. Each creature there must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) cold damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.

tr: Storm Body
A creature that hits the kite with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
Flyby
The kite doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
a: Multiattack
The kite makes three Lightning Tail attacks.
Lightning Tail
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) lightning damage.
Gale Burst (Recharge 5–6)
Each creature in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) thunder damage and being pushed 30 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.
